Safer by default, and ready for public install: commands on your PC always ask, risky files don't open by accident, and a webhook crash is fixed.

## Install

Download **`Hermes-Bots-Setup-1.8.4.exe`** below and run it. It installs over 1.x and keeps your settings and chats.

- **Not code-signed.** Windows SmartScreen will say "Windows protected your PC". Click **More info → Run anyway**.
- No auto-update: install a newer `Hermes-Bots-Setup-<version>.exe` over this one.

## Security

- **Commands on your PC always ask.** A terminal command on This PC now shows only **Allow once** and **Deny**. Clicks, typing and key presses can still be allowed for a chat.
- **Files that can run code don't open by accident.** A bot's executable or script is shown in its folder instead of being opened.
- **Only configured machines are reachable from the app's page.** Requests to any other address are blocked.
- **Event webhooks no longer crash on a bad signature.** The HMAC check now rejects the request instead of stopping the app.

## Fixed

- **Group replies go one at a time.** A message that wakes several bots no longer has them all answer at once.
- **The installed app is smoke-tested in CI** before a release, so a broken build no longer ships quietly.

## Other

- Demo data and test fixtures no longer contain personal names or accounts.
